## Comparison of the Two Traces

Both traces follow an identical core deductive chain: Bo leads 0 → S1/S2/S8 share a leader (Rules 2+9) → eliminate Ana (Rule 10), Cy (Rule 1), Bo (Rule 3), Di (Rule 8, 3 > 2) → Ed leads S1/S2/S8 → cascade through Rules 4→6→11→5→7 → full assignment. Neither trace diverges in its core reasoning.

The divergence is purely in verification behavior. Trace 1 is far more verbose, re-deriving the chain at least four times in different paraphrases and repeatedly re-checking individual sessions (S4, S5, S7). It also muses about implicit assumptions not grounded in the prompt (whether all staff must lead sessions, whether "5 staff" implies everyone works). Trace 2 is more concise but still re-derives the chain two to three times. The sibling trace confirms that the musing about implicit assumptions in Trace 1 was unproductive—Trace 2 never raises these concerns and reaches the same answer. Similarly, the repeated re-derivations in both traces produce no new constraints or information; they merely confirm the already-established solution.
